critical_code_review_comments: Inline onclick uses string-concatenation rather than a multi-line template literal; readable but easy to introduce a syntax error if extended. Consider a small helper that JSON.stringifies the inline source to guarantee escaping if more cleanup snippets are ever added.

The document-level capture-phase delegator does NOT call e.preventDefault() / e.stopPropagation() — intentional per inline comment (lets inline onclick also run for idempotency). If a future card variant inside .bp-quick-grid ever gets a competing handler, this becomes a foot-gun. Worth a note in the function header.

setupWalletClickDelegator is registered on document for the entire SPA lifetime; on every click anywhere in the app it runs target.closest('[data-testid="brand-dash-wallet"]'). Negligible cost, but if more such delegators are added a single shared delegator with a switch on data-testid would scale better.
